pkgmetadata.longdescription: Hiedi is HeDE's local-first, cloud-on-consent assistant for building and planning — for anything, not just software. A project is a Voyage: a goal, a Chart (waypoints and a DAG of tasks), and a Logbook, all stored as plain YAML and Markdown the user owns. The local brain (Ollama) drafts and revises the plan; an optional cloud brain (Claude) is gated per-Voyage. Every action Hiedi takes passes a per-Voyage permission gate (deny/ask/allow) and is recorded with who and which brain did it. Ships a Qt summon panel (hiedi), a session daemon (hiedid, org.hede.hiedi), and a headless CLI (hiedi-voyage).
